reuse.why: Routes the rule through the existing shouldFillCategory selection, but detects the tag with its own regex instead of the tree's shared tag parser (extractTagsFromText in shared/tags.ts).

duplication.why: The notes join and group_notes column are added identically to three separate queries, and the #fixed regex re-implements tag parsing that shared/tags.ts already provides.

placement.why: The exclusion lives in fill-categories.ts, the module that defines which categories month-wide actions write to; only the data plumbing is in actions.ts.

scope.why: Only the queries, the candidate type, the selection function and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: One rule in the shared selection function is easy to own; the bespoke regex with different escaping semantics from the app's tag rules and the triplicated join are minor liabilities.

bypasses_abstraction.where: fill-categories.ts isFixedGroup uses its own /(^|\s)#fixed(?![\w-])/ regex instead of extractTagsFromText from shared/tags.ts, so '##fixed' escaping and tag delimiters differ from the rest of the app.

disguised_duplication.where: The tag regex is an independent reimplementation rather than a renamed copy; the repeated LEFT JOIN notes is plain repetition across the three existing queries.

one_place.where: fill-categories.ts shouldFillCategory (isFixedGroup) is used by copy-previous-month, setZero and the averages; each query only supplies group_notes.
